summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 1,145,836 shares of common stock at $9.77 per share for an aggregate $11.19 million (settled July 20, 2026) in an exempt private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. Separately, the board declared a $0.068 per share dividend (record July 21, pay July 29). The filing also discloses NAV of $9.77 as of June 30, 2026. Neither a capital return, tender offer, nor special-situation event; it is a routine sale of securities and dividend declaration.
